audit.why: Pantheon wins 1-5 (bait the hop, all-in its 16s downtime); Fizz takes over at 6 with Chum + untargetability and keeps it through items. Content and packet chart agree (Pantheon x4, Fizz x3); 55.68% WR fits.
All 4 spikes present: 3-5 Pantheon window, Fizz 6 flip, Fizz 1st-item one-shot, Fizz late. Grounded in the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart blanket Skill vs content/packet agreement; cooldowns field digitless; two verbatim trade-line bullets; missing interaction: Fizz's burst opens with the Seastone Trident (W) auto-reset wind-up.
audit.why: Fizz E is 16/14/12/10/8 — the untargetable hop that dodges Pantheon's whole combo is the lane's gate. W auto-reset is the burst tell. R Chum grounds and knocks up.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned with grounded whys; cooldowns rewritten with the 16s E number; auto-reset tell folded into dosFull[1].d; bleed bullets replaced.

edits.before: Grand Starfall online — your shoves become bot-lane invoices. The early lead must become the map now.
edits.after: R Chum plus the untargetable hop flips it — your all-in whiffs into Playful and his ult comes back at you.

edits.before: First item spike: the stun-spear rotation deletes squishies. Last call before scaling lanes wake.
edits.after: First item AP turns E-into-R into a one-shot that dodges your engage — his kill pressure, not yours.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: Two-plus items he dodges your leap with the E hop and assassinates through your combo — group up and let CC catch him mid-hop instead.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. It governs your forward steps. - E Aegis Assault spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — a 16s cooldown at rank 1 (8 at max); the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo, so bait it before spending burst. - E Aegis Assault spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: His burst opens with the Seastone Trident auto-reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to W first.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Post-item his E-R one-shots through a spent Aegis — once your block ends and his hop is up, the duel is his, so leave.
